messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a canary for models.v3_2 next week. Proposal: percent-based + region-scoped ramp. Want to lock down percentages, guardrails, and rollout steps. TL;DR: us-east1 2% -> 10% -> 50%, eu-west1 1% -> 5% -> 20%, ap-southeast1 hold. Thoughts?
jess: sounds reasonable. prefer 24h observation windows between steps; also use a feature flag key like `canary_model_v3_2` so we can flip quickly.
sudeep: +1 on windows. need to define auto-rollback triggers up front: error-rate, latency regressions, and eval regressions. propose thresholds: error-rate > 1.5% absolute, p95 latency +30% vs baseline, eval divergence (our regression harness) > 4%.
maria: and add infra guardrails: GPU node utilization < 80% (per-node) and cap concurrent sessions per org to 5 for canary traffic. prevents noisy neighbors.
alex: good catches. plan is to implement LD flag `flags/redwood/canary_model_v3_2` and use routing policy `model_override=v3_2` when flag true. we'll stage by customer tag + region. need a terraform change for the flag/segmentation and a small runtime change to respect the region-weighted rollout.
devops-bot: FYI: canary pipeline PR created -> #3124 (helm + k8s label changes). deploy pipeline will tag pods with `canary=v3_2` and add traffic weights.
jess: ping @eng-oncall to monitor first 6 hours and increase trace sampling for canary traces. also add an alert for the 'response_model_mismatch' metric (new metric we added last quarter).
sudeep: @eng-oncall — any objection to starting Mon 09:00 PT? prefer avoid EMEA midnight.
karen: no objections, i'll be oncall that day. also suggest restricting stage 1 audience to `internal` + `beta-customers` org tag. stage 2 expands to 5% of non-enterprise customers.
alex: agreed. stage plan in brief:
- Stage 0: internal only (smoke)
- Stage 1: internal + beta-customers, us-east1 2%, eu-west1 1% (24h)
- Stage 2: expand to us-east1 10%, eu-west1 5% (24h)
- Stage 3: us-east1 50%, eu-west1 20%, consider ap-southeast1 after monitoring
Rollback triggers: error-rate >1.5% OR p95 +30% OR eval divergence >4% OR GPU-util >80% or alert flood. Fallback: `fallback_to_v3_1`.
maria: make sure sticky sessions map back to original model when flag removed. and record a canary tag in traces for easy query.
devops-bot: :thumbsup: PR #3124 merged into staging. When ready, ops will set LD targets: us-east1=2%, eu-west1=1% for `flags/redwood/canary_model_v3_2`.
jess: i'll do the LD rollout once staging deploy is green. i'll post the exact LD segments and the healthcare/regulatory exclusion list before flipping.
alex: thanks — if no blockers by EOD Fri we'll start Mon morning. i'll update the rollout doc and add dashboard links + runbook. please flag any missing guardrail items here before EOD.
